name: drydock
description: Drydock — plan-first parallel execution for Claude Code.

plugins.name: drydock
plugins.description: Keeps an AI agent inside the files you said it may touch: a hook denies writes outside a declared scope, Bash writes are detected, and an audit checks the diff. Use it alone, beside any planner, as a PR check, or with plan-first parallel waves. Nothing sails until it leaves the dock.
